 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest today is Alyssa Ravasio, Co-Founder and CEO of Hipcamp, a platform to discover and book your next camping trip. I was excited for this conversation as it combines two of my favorite passions, the outdoors and entrepreneurship. In our discussion, we cover how Alyssa bootstrapped demand in the early days of Hipcamp, the importance of creating not just great experiences but magical ones, and the evolution of Hipcamp's business model. After listening to this episode I'm sure the first thing you want to do is get outside in nature. Please enjoy my conversation with Alyssa Ravasio.

 Alyssa's Journey Before Hipcamp 
 Patrick 
Alyssa, I think we need to start at the beginning. This is one I've been looking to because it unites probably my two top passions, the technology software marketplace world and the outdoors. So I've been dying to talk to you about what you're building at Hipcamp. I'd love to hear the kernel of original insight that led you to start this business as a place to jump off.
